metadata.compatibility_note: A device is compatible with a machine when: (device.flags_value & 0x1FFFFF) is non-zero AND (machine.bus_flags_value & (device.flags_value & 0x1FFFFF)) != 0. Exception: DEVICE_PCI devices are excluded from machines with MACHINE_PCI_INTERNAL flag set (flags bit 0x200000).
metadata.cfg_note: In the 86Box CFG file, each device is saved under a section named after the device internal_name. Each config entry .name is the key. Integer/selection values are stored as decimals; hex values as 0x-prefixed hex.
